newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Valepar consortium has five member groups.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Valepar consortium has five member groups.

text.p: The Valepar consortium which bought 41.73 percent of the voting shares of Brazilian mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) is led by Brazilian steelmaker CSN.
The composition of the consortium, as registered for the Special Purpose Company that will be formed and have control of CVRD, was registered as follows:
-- CSN with 16.30 percent or 40.7 million shares valued at 1.303 billion reais.

-- Opportunity Asset Management with 10 percent or 25 million shares valued at 800 million reais. -- Four local pension funds -- Previ, Funcef, Funcesp and Petros -- with 10.43 percent or 26.07 million shares valued at 834.5 million reais.
-- NationsBank Corp with 5.0 percent or 12.5 million shares valued at 400 million reais.
-- Cia Suzano with one share at 32 reais.
Prior to the auction, CSN has said that Citicorp and George Soros were investing in Opportunity Asset Management's offshore Sweet River investment fund for foreign, mainly U.S. investors.
South Africa's Gencor signed a letter of intent with Valepar to join the consortium after the auction, while Suzano was still negotiating to increase its stake.
